description: This file defines the DocStore_DocumentLoaders class, which implements data loading from document stores, including methods to list available stores and initialize document retrieval, integrating with a database via TypeORM and handling document content.

classes.name: DocStore_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class implementing document store data loading, with methods to list stores and initialize document retrieval, conforming to the INode interface.

methods.name: loadMethods.listStores
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of document stores with status 'SYNC' from the database.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes document loading by fetching chunks from the database and returning either document objects or concatenated text.
